notes: This directory is the authoritative staged golden ISA definition for v0.57.0.
v0.57.0 adds 32-bit CAS (Compare-And-Swap) instructions with register reuse pattern.
New instruction group encoding: 6..4=3'b000, 3..1=3'b110 (avoiding DMA conflict).
Adds CASB, CASH, CASW, CASD to complement existing 48-bit HL.CAS* instructions.
